run_estimateleres: run the estimateleres function to generate a depth map prediction from an RGB image using a Leres model
run_estimateboost: run the estimateboost function to generate a high-resolution depth map with local patch refinement and double estimation
run_calculateprocessingres: run the calculateprocessingres function to compute the optimal processing resolution and patch scale for an input image
create_generatemask: create a Gaussian blending mask for seamless patch merging using the generatemask function
run_generatepatchs: run the generatepatchs function to extract adaptive local patches from an image based on gradient density for depth refinement
